title: Occupy the k-th Empty Slot
prompt:
**Bài toán.** n empty slots, q operations: `1 k` — occupy the k-th
still-empty slot and print its position; `2 p` — print 1 if slot p is
occupied, else 0.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200 000; k never exceeds the number of empty
slots. Op 1 must be O(log n) — the descent walk on empty counts.

tests.name: first three
cursor trap
tests.hint: Occupy 2nd empty = 2, then 1st empty = 1 (an empty BEFORE the cursor). A scan-from-cursor wrongly returns 3.

tests.name: n=200000 heavy k
tests.hint: Each op takes the 100000th empty: 100000, then 100001, ... Skipped-behind empties accumulate — linear scans die here.
